name: start
step: Start: tmux_lib is Python only (tmux_lib.py, tmux_lib_internal.py, and pytest tests), and stranger_test.py writes 7 tmux helpers by hand that tmux_lib does not have.

name: ts-project-setup
step: Add package.json with a "test": "bun test" script, a strict tsconfig.json, and @types/bun to this repo.
why: Every later step writes TypeScript, and the test loop in 'suite-green-loop' runs npm run test.
how: Keep the Python files and pyproject.toml as they are; the Python copy stays.

name: lib-empty-functions
step: One haiku agent per Python library file creates tmux_lib.ts and tmux_lib_internal.ts with one empty function for each Python function, and writes a 'func, file' line for each into funcNames.txt.
why: Empty functions with the final names let one agent per function in 'lib-port-functions' fill in bodies without touching other functions.
how: Each .ts file exports one object; all functions of that file are members of it and call each other through it, so tests can spyOn any function. The object also has run (the process call) and sleep members that replace subprocess.run and time.sleep, so tests lose no faking power. Follow the user's pseudocode: createFile(funcNames.txt); per file, agent(model=haiku, effort=high) collects function names and arg lists, writes empty functions, appends 'func, file' lines.

name: lib-port-functions
step: One haiku agent per line of funcNames.txt ports that function's Python body into the matching empty TypeScript function, with a type on every variable.
why: The library must work in TypeScript before tests can be ported against it.
how: for [func, file] in funcNames.txt: agent(model=haiku, effort=high, prompt='port func from file.py to typescript, write it as the body of func in file.ts, type every variable').

name: lib-typecheck
step: bunx tsc --noEmit reports no errors in tmux_lib.ts and tmux_lib_internal.ts.
why: bun test does not check types, so type errors from the per-function agents must be caught before the tests are ported.

name: test-scaffold-files
step: Create one empty test file tests/<name>.test.ts for each Python file tests/<name>.py.
why: bun test only finds files named *.test.ts, and the per-file agents in 'test-empty-functions' need a file to write into.
how: for file in tests/*.py: touch tests/${file}.test.ts (example: tests/test_tmux_lib.test.ts).

name: test-func-names
step: One agent writes testFuncNames.txt with one 'func, file' line for every test function in every Python test file.
why: 'test-empty-functions' and 'test-port-functions' spawn one agent per line of this file.

name: test-fixture-helpers
step: Each pytest fixture in the Python test files becomes a plain helper function in the matching .test.ts file, with its cleanup in afterEach.
why: The 20 pytest fixtures (for example tmux_session_clean) have no TypeScript match, and the ported test bodies call them.
how: A test calls the helper at its start; capsys becomes spyOn on the stderr or stdout write the library uses.

name: test-empty-functions
step: One sonnet agent per test file creates an empty bun test for each line of testFuncNames.txt for that file, with the same name as the Python test.
why: Empty tests with final names let one agent per test in 'test-port-functions' fill in bodies without touching other tests.
how: Walk testFuncNames.txt; start a new agent(model=sonnet, effort=high) when the file changes; message it per test: 'read func signature from file.py, create func in file.test.ts with the same signature'. Fixture arguments become calls to the helpers from 'test-fixture-helpers'.

name: test-port-functions
step: One haiku agent per line of testFuncNames.txt ports that test's Python body into the matching empty TypeScript test, with a type on every variable.
why: Each Python test must check the same behavior in TypeScript.
how: monkeypatch.setattr and patch.object become spyOn on the exported object, including its run and sleep members.

name: test-typecheck
step: bunx tsc --noEmit reports no errors across the library and all .test.ts files.
why: bun test does not check types, so type errors in the ported tests must be caught before the test loop.

name: suite-green-loop
step: The full bun test suite passes with no failing tests.
why: A passing suite proves the TypeScript copy behaves the same as the Python copy.
how: Loop: failures = npm run test; stop when none; for each failing test, agent(model=sonnet, effort=high, prompt='fix the code being tested by failure.test until it passes').

name: stranger-helpers-agreed
step: The claude_hooks session and the user agree on which of the 7 hand-written tmux helpers in stranger_test.py move into tmux_lib.
why: Only helpers that are generic tmux work belong in the library; the rest stay in the test.
how: The 7: answer_dialog, the launch readiness loop, wait_turn_end, pane_turns, wait_for_idle_exit, the raw tmux new-session call when TMUX_PANE is unset, and the raw tmux kill-pane -a cleanup. The question is already sent to the 'finish claude_hooks' session.

name: stranger-helpers-added
step: Each helper agreed in 'stranger-helpers-agreed' exists in the TypeScript copy only, as a member of the exported object, with a passing bun test.
why: The ported stranger test must import these helpers from tmux_lib instead of writing them by hand.
how: Agreed list: (a) answer_dialog as a helper; tmux_waitForClaudeReadiness fixed in place to skip the dialog's ❯ and throw on a '/login' or 'login method' screen, with the poll count, poll interval, and post-dialog wait (now 120 x 1 s and 2 s) as parameters; update its ported test to match. (b) tmux_waitForTurnEnd: busy regex, settle time, timeout, answers dialogs while waiting, optional regex for short-lived screen text, and a callback for the caller's own activity check (the test's transcript size check stays in the test). (c) tmux_waitForPaneClose(pane, timeout) and tmux_paneExists(pane). (d) tmux_killOtherPanes(pane). (e) tmux_newAttachedSession. (f) tmux_capturePaneToFile. pane_turns, the self re-run when TMUX_PANE is unset, and the transcript readers stay in the test. tmux_sendAndSubmit sends text unchanged; the test keeps its own trailing space. Every helper accepts a pane id such as %3 as its target.

name: goal
step: Goal: tmux_lib has a tested TypeScript copy next to the Python copy, and the TypeScript copy has every tmux function stranger_test.py needs, including the tmux helpers stranger_test.py now writes by hand.
